items.title: Long work reports its progress: done of total, rate and ETA, or what it can when it cannot
Progress: long work says how far it is
The progress rule is listed for everyone as a must enforced by progress-declared, and can be retired (test/plugins/long-work/progress.test.ts, on Deno, Node and Bun)
A run's progress line is shown with its rate and ETA by run status, run list and wait, here and on a host (test/plugins/long-work/progress.test.ts, on Deno, Node and Bun)
A run silent past --stale is stale; a --no-progress run shows its reason, elapsed time and last log line (test/plugins/long-work/progress.test.ts, on Deno, Node and Bun)
verify, metrics run and tools install report their progress through the core reporter (test/plugins/long-work/progress-commands.test.ts, on Deno, Node and Bun)
The check progress-declared flags long work declared with neither progress nor a reason (test/plugins/long-work/progress.test.ts, on Deno, Node and Bun)
